title: Plynth edit session lock, version 1
description: The session.lock file in a project folder, written by plynth session begin and removed by plynth session end. While it is active the app is read only. It expires when last_activity is more than 300 seconds old.

pid.description: Id of the process that ran session begin. For display only.

tool.description: Who is editing, from session begin --tool. Shown in the app banner.
